in_hebrew.name: עידולה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew root 'ydl', meaning 'to wander'. Idolla could be interpreted as 'the wandering image' or 'the idol that roams'. In biblical contexts, this name would likely be used to refer to an idolatrous image or goddess.

in_greek.name: Ιδολλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'ειδολος' (eidolos), meaning 'image'. Idolla in Greek contexts would likely be used to refer to an idol or idolatrous figure.

in_latin.name: Idolla
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'idolum', meaning 'image'. Idolla in Latin contexts would likely be used to refer to an idol or idolatrous figure.
